note: AMD Jaguar architecture was released in 2013 on 28nm technology.
Typical processors include A4-5000, A6-5200, A8-6410, A10-5745M, etc.
This processor iGPU is unsupported in all macOS versions. Laptops with supported discrete GPUs can run up to macOS Monterey 12.

note: Ryzen 2000-5000 series APUs use NootedRed driver, supporting Metal acceleration but without VDA hardware decoding.
NootedRed supports the entire Vega Raven ASIC family (from Ryzen 1000/Athlon series up to Ryzen 5000 and 7x30 series).
Supports macOS Catalina 10.15 through macOS Tahoe 26. Recommend newer point releases (e.g. Big Sur 11.6 vs 11.0).
Ryzen 2000-5000 APUs can reduce OpenGL rendering overhead in Chromium browsers.
Recommend allocating 2GB+ VRAM for AMD APU graphics in BIOS settings.
